reason: 99 euros is nothing next to what I pay my freelancer, but I'm not swapping a person who knows my clients for 'AI co-workers' on the strength of a landing page. At most I'd open the free plan, and I wouldn't pay anything this month.
objection: I don't believe an AI 'Marketing Manager' gets the work done the way my freelancer does without me checking everything, and I have no idea what 100 credits actually buys before I run out.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle one real job for my business, like a month of social posts or answering our support inbox, at a quality I'd sign off on without rewriting it, so I could cut the freelancer's hours.
